title: Count for the canonical sign vector
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, let $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$ have value $1$ at coordinate $i$ exactly when $i<k$, and value $-1$ otherwise. The number of coordinates of $x$ equal to $1$ is $\\min(n,k)$.
